```{r setup, include = FALSE}

data.table::setDTthreads(1)
```

The goal of this vignette is to give some examples of how to benchmark the C++ code.

```{r}
result_list <- atime::atime(
  setup={
    N_points <- N*10
    N_queries <- N
    dataScale <- 10
    N_list <- Poncatime:::generate_data_interface(N_points, N_queries, dataScale)
  },
  seconds.limit=1,
  result=TRUE,
  asoCurvatureEstimation=with(N_list, data.frame(count=Poncatime:::asoCurvatureEstimation_interface(points, queries, dataScale/5)))
)
plot(result_list)

ref_list <- atime::references_best(result_list)
library(ggplot2)
plot(ref_list)+
  theme(text=element_text(size=20))

pred_list <- predict(ref_list)
plot(pred_list)
```
